_comment: Read by Dev Tools/b_t.py at build time. images/ and sounds/ MUST ship with every build: the alarm picture is read from images/ next to the exe, so a build without it can only flash a plain colour, and sounds/ holds the selectable WAV alerts. Dev Tools/cm_t.py then deploys those folders to the share. The three editing tabs are listed as hidden imports because main.py loads them by name (__import__ on a variable), which PyInstaller cannot see - without these the program starts with three red 'tab could not be built' pages. The Qt exclusions are the same ones Image Tools uses; none of this program touches QML, Quick or 3D.
